verdict.rationale: CAM is a law firm, but its own pages say it uses AI and ML legaltech in day-to-day practice, so a client could fairly ask whether their data can be kept out of AI model training. Nothing in the evidence documents an opt-out, a no-training commitment, or any client data-use control for AI. The DPDP article and the TMT data-privacy page describe advisory services to clients, not the firm's own handling of client data, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
